verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a decision retrieval path: a `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/decision` polling endpoint and decision webhooks sent right after a decision. The only explicit mention of extracted data is the iOS SDK NFC listener, which gives client-side access to "extracted NFC data" from identity documents. None of the evidence shows that the decision payload contains structured document fields rather than a status, so support for the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented decision/webhook payload schema listing name, date of birth, document number, address and expiry fields; server-side API retrieval of extracted fields beyond NFC SDK callbacks; independent or hands-on corroboration.
